subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard introduce a durable `ready_to_merge` status and fail-closed completion gate, or should review approval reuse the existing lifecycle states?
rationale: The PR changes stored card state and completion behavior in ways that can stop existing Workboard workflows at runtime, so a maintainer needs to choose the intended lifecycle before this can merge.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Keep the new lifecycle direction only after the gate, response envelope, metadata, UI consumers, tests, and upgrade proof are all fixed.

options.title: Reuse existing statuses
options.body: Redesign review approval around current Workboard statuses to avoid adding a durable `ready_to_merge` state.

options.title: Defer the lifecycle change
options.body: Pause or close this PR until a Workboard owner sponsors the review-gate product direction.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the new lifecycle direction only after the gate, response envelope, metadata, UI consumers, tests, and upgrade proof are all fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored and merged the central Workboard plugin/tool/manifest history and is the strongest routing candidate for lifecycle direction.
